title: feat(client): retry transient failures with capped exponential backoff
body:
## What

`Client.Do` now retries transient failures with exponential backoff capped at `MaxDelay`, and returns as soon as the context is cancelled. Attempt outcomes are counted in the `attempts` table for the dashboard.

## Why

The billing sync fails a few times a day on transient 503s from the upstream API.
author: rgarcia
